evidence.actual: AADSTS7000215: Invalid client secret provided. Ensure the secret being sent in the request is the client secret value, not the client secret ID
evidence.note: The authorization server rejected the client credential.
Exact match with a registered URI, so this is not the cause.
A confidential client authenticates with a secret at the token endpoint.

output.fix: Check the client secret that the token request sends. In the Entra app registration, open Certificates & secrets. Copy the secret Value, not the Secret ID. The Value is shown only once, when the secret is created. Check that the secret has not expired. If it has, create a new secret and store it in your secret manager. Update the client configuration with it. Make sure the secret belongs to this app (client-abc123) and tenant, and that no stray whitespace or encoding changes were added. Do not turn off client authentication or put the secret in the front channel.

alternatives.why_not: The code_verifier matches the S256 code_challenge, so the PKCE check passed.
The redirect_uri exactly matches a registered URI.
